requirements.description: User wants the property near public transport. 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93, rounded to 71).
A university student residence is essential to be close to universities. The education score is set to the 75th percentile of the distribution (75.14, rounded to 75).
User prefers energy class C or better, so classes A1 through C are accepted. Area, capacity, location (Turin) and public transport requirements are not energy requirements and are excluded.

The user explicitly requires a gross floor area of at least 850 sqm. The 60-person capacity is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-area threshold per occupant was supplied. Energy class, public transport proximity, and the CDP/PNRR conversion purpose are not REFERENCE COLUMNS and are not used as filters.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 850 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND mobility >= 71 AND education >= 75 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters on property_type (the filterable equivalent of tipologia_bene_immobile) = 'Uffici e assimilabili', surface_area >= 850, a 3.0 km haversine radius around (45.0677551, 7.6824892), energy_class in A1–A4/B/C, mobility >= 71 and education >= 75. Results are ordered by distance from the center. The 60-person capacity is not an extracted requirement and is not applied.
